interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open: This unit is conducting a census of the living. Attendance was nine hundred and forty-one. Attendance is now nine hundred and forty. State your presence.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open.refus: You don't have the authority to count us.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open.mark: Say nothing. The warmth in your chest says it for you.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.census: At the hour the tolling stopped, where were you? Answers will be recorded in aggregate.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.census.tog: Together. All of us. The whole time.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.fixate: One of you is standing closer to the silence than the others. This unit has not yet determined which.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.fixate.loo: Look at your shoes. Your very interesting shoes.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.attest: The Wardenate requires a statement of collective innocence. All present must attest. The statement is not valid if any voice abstains.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.close: Attested. Filed. This unit thanks you for your continued existence, which will be re-verified at the next census.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.noted: Noted. This unit has amended the record. The record now contains your name, and room for further entries.
interregnum.dlg.reprompt: The statement is not valid. Answer again.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.ledger: The offering box is short. Not by much. Fourteen units of account, which in the old measure is a loaf, a candle, and something the register lists only as warmth. I am required to reconcile before the quarter closes.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.ledger.adm: It was us. We took it.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.report: For the quarter's report. It goes in the slot in the north wall with the others. I have not been told to stop.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.report.pre: Has anyone told you anything at all?
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.stop: No. That would also have to come from somewhere.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.stop.then_: Then let us make the number right.
Nobody is reading them. You know that.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.restore: Anything of comparable warmth. The register was never particular about what. That was the kindness of it, I think. I will enter it under offerings, unprompted, which is its own column and a rarer one.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.restore.re: On second thought, we need it more.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.admit: Thank you. I will record it as a withdrawal against an authorised holder. That is not what it was. But the register has a column for that, and no column for what it was.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.admit.refu: Don't call us authorised. We weren't.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.admit.tell: There is nothing on the other end of that slot.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.truth.pres: Then why are you still counting?
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.remarks:
Noted. Under remarks.

The quarter closes at moonrise. You are welcome to attend. Most people do not.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.close_sign: Balanced. Filed. Thank you for your patience with the process.
interregnum.dlg.shrine_keeper.close_unsi: Unreconciled, then. It carries to next quarter. It will carry for some time.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.wake:
Executor. Sit.

You are asleep, so sitting is a formality. I have found the formalities are what is left.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.wake.who: Why are you calling me that?
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.wake.sorr: I didn't mean to. Any of it.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.wake.refu: I'm not doing anything for you.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.name:
Because it is the office you are holding. You did not apply for it.

Neither did I.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.estate:
There is an estate. It is the sky, and the rules about falling, and why the dead burn at dawn, and a family that has not answered me in some time.

Someone has to settle it.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.letters:
Each of them holds a world and cannot leave it. That was always the arrangement. It was never once a comfort.

I wrote. I was not answered. I have decided not to know why.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.terms:
You are carrying what I was. It does not fit. It will not begin to fit.

Take the post. Find someone the office fits, and put them in it. Or do not, and watch what I was holding come apart at the edges, where nobody is looking.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.cost:
Nothing. There is nobody left to pay you.

I would have, once. I would have been generous, and you would have found the terms baffling.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.charged:
Then it is yours.

I will be here. I am afraid I will be here rather a lot.
interregnum.dlg.dream_audience.decline:
As you like.

Declining is not a door. I will ask again. I have nothing but time and no way to spend it.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.greet:
You are the first in some while. That is not a complaint; the register has no column for footfall.

If it is the box you want, the box is there.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.explains:
Offerings. People leave what they can spare, I record what they leave, and at the quarter it goes in the slot in the north wall.

After that it is somebody else's arithmetic.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.offering: Anything you can spare. I will write it under offerings, unprompted, which is its own column and a rarer one than you would think.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.offering.g: Here. Put it down as unprompted.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.offering.d: On second thought, we'll hold onto it.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.permission:
Ah. No. Not you, and not me either -- it opens for the one it is addressed to.

Nobody has come to open it in a very long time. I keep it tidy anyway. It would be embarrassing otherwise.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.shrug:
The register says: the holder.

I have never needed to write anything else down. You will forgive me. It has not come up.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.thanks:
Recorded. Thank you.

It is a good day for that column.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.no_offerin: Of course. The box is not a toll. I will note that you stopped, if you don't mind -- footfall has no column, but visits do.
interregnum.dlg.keeper_intact.leave: Safe roads. The steles are readable if you have the light for it; most people don't bother, and I have never held it against anybody.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.resented.ri: The standing order against you has been reduced to a notice.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.wary.rise: The Wardenate has downgraded your citation to a matter of record.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.trusted.ris: A Warden has begun to address you before you speak.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.beloved.ris: You have been entered into the register as a party in good standing. Nobody congratulates you.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.trusted.fal: An amendment has been filed against your record. Your standing survives it.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.known.fall: The Wardenate has stopped addressing you first.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.wary.fall: The Wardenate has opened a file on you.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.resented.fa: Your file has been forwarded. It is not stated to whom.
interregnum.regard.wardenate.hated.fall: A standing order has been issued in your name. You are not shown it.
interregnum.regard.villages.resented.ris: Somebody in a village you have never entered has said your name without spitting.
interregnum.regard.villages.wary.rise: The doors have stopped closing early on your account.
interregnum.regard.villages.known.rise: Somebody nodded to you, and it was not a mistake.
interregnum.regard.villages.trusted.rise: A village has started keeping a share of something back for you.
interregnum.regard.villages.beloved.rise: Children have begun to be named for the thing you did.
interregnum.regard.villages.trusted.fall: The share kept back for you is smaller, and nobody mentions it.
interregnum.regard.villages.known.fall: Conversation continues when you arrive now. It did not used to.
interregnum.regard.villages.resented.fal: A door was shut before you reached it.
interregnum.regard.villages.hated.fall: You are spoken of in the past tense, in villages you have never entered.
interregnum.regard.verdant.resented.rise: A path you cut some time ago is still open.
interregnum.regard.verdant.wary.rise: The undergrowth has stopped closing quite so fast behind you.
interregnum.regard.verdant.known.rise: Something green has grown toward you rather than over you.
interregnum.regard.verdant.trusted.rise: The way ahead opens a little before you reach it.
interregnum.regard.verdant.beloved.rise: The forest has begun to keep your paths for you.
interregnum.regard.verdant.trusted.fall: A path you keep has begun to need keeping.
interregnum.regard.verdant.known.fall: The green closes behind you sooner than it did.
interregnum.regard.verdant.wary.fall: The way you came is no longer the way you came.
interregnum.regard.verdant.resented.fall: Roots have taken a doorway you meant to use again.
interregnum.regard.verdant.hated.fall: The forest has closed. Not against you specifically. It does not need to be specific.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.resented.ri: Something you were carrying is easier to carry.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.wary.rise: The ground feels more like ground.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.known.rise: What you set down stays where you set it.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.trusted.ris: You are being held, in the way that weight is a kind of being held.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.beloved.ris: Nothing you have anchored has drifted, and nothing is going to.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.trusted.fal: Something you had fixed in place has shifted a little.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.known.fall: Your footing is exactly as good as it was, and you have started checking it.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.wary.fall: Things you set down have begun to be found elsewhere.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.resented.fa: The weight of what you carry has stopped being distributed kindly.
interregnum.regard.anchorite.hated.fall: Nothing holds. The Anchorite is not doing this to you. It has stopped doing it for you.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.resente: Something of yours that was wearing through has stopped.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.wary.ri: Your gear is holding its edge longer than the work explains.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.known.r: A place you left is exactly as you left it.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.trusted: Something you thought lost has turned up unaged.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.beloved: You have been written into a past that will be kept.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.trusted: A thing you keep has begun to show its age.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.known.f: Your gear has started to weather faster than the work explains.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.wary.fa: A place you left has moved on without you.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.resente: Something you built is older than you built it.
interregnum.regard.hearth_turner.hated.f: Everything you touch is being remembered as it will be, not as it is.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.resented.ri: The silence from that direction has changed. You could not say how.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.wary.rise: You have stopped expecting an answer, and the not-answering has stopped feeling like refusal.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.known.rise: Something did not answer you, and for the first time it felt like company.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.trusted.ris: The quiet has begun to make room for you.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.beloved.ris: You are being kept inside the silence rather than outside it.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.trusted.fal: The quiet is a little less room than it was.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.known.fall: The silence has gone back to being silence.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.wary.fall: Nothing has answered you. It is not clear that anything is listening.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.resented.fa: The not-answering has begun to feel deliberate.
interregnum.regard.quiet_one.hated.fall: You have been unheard, thoroughly, and there is no appeal from it.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.resented.ri: Something that had stopped attending to you is attending again.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.wary.rise: The dreams have gone quiet. Not absent. Quiet.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.known.rise: You are being addressed, in your sleep, as though correspondence had resumed.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.trusted.ris: The letters you carry have begun to feel like yours to answer.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.beloved.ris: You are not forgiven. You are, apparently, trusted with it.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.trusted.fal: Something withdrew a little, in the way of somebody deciding not to say a thing.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.known.fall: The dreams have changed their subject.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.wary.fall: You wake with the sense of having been looked at and set aside.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.resented.fa: The dreams have begun to repeat one moment, and it is not one you chose.
interregnum.regard.the_ghost.hated.fall: There is nothing left to hear from that direction, and the silence has weight.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open.attes: We're present. And we'll answer for the ones who aren't.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open.alrea: Before you ask. Yes. It's us.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open.filed:
This unit is conducting a census of the living. Attendance was nine hundred and forty-one. Attendance is now nine hundred and forty.

Your designation appears in three prior returns. State your presence.
interregnum.dlg.warden_intake.open.known:
This unit is conducting a census of the living. Attendance was nine hundred and forty-one. Attendance is now nine hundred and forty.

Your returns have been accepted without amendment. State your presence.
interregnum.dlg.keeper.ledger.known_of:
The offering box is short. Fourteen units of account.

Your party is in the register already, under remarks, in another keeper's hand. I have not read it closely. I am required to reconcile before the quarter closes, and I would rather do that than the other thing.
interregnum.dlg.keeper.ledger.welcome:
Oh -- it's you. Good.

The offering box is short. Fourteen units of account, which in the old measure is a loaf, a candle, and something the register lists only as warmth. I am sorry to raise it with you of all people. I am required to reconcile before the quarter closes.
interregnum.dlg.warden_interrogation.can:
This unit is taking statements. The count is not in dispute. The timing is.

Attendance fell by one at a moment this unit cannot fix, and the register requires a moment. Where were you.

This unit is taking statements. Your party has given one before. This unit will ask the same questions in the same order, because that is how they are asked.

Attendance fell by one at a moment this unit cannot fix. Where were you.

This unit is taking statements. Your party's previous returns were consistent. That is recorded and it is not a finding.

Attendance fell by one at a moment this unit cannot fix. Where were you.
What is it you're actually asking?
Do you want help taking the rest of them?
interregnum.dlg.warden_interrogation.exp:
The overworld's authority has ceased. This unit is not authorised to characterise it further.

This unit is authorised to take statements. It is taking them. Where were you.
interregnum.dlg.warden_interrogation.shr:
Recorded. Which shrine.

This unit asks every party the same questions in the same order. It is not an accusation. Nothing about you has been marked.
interregnum.dlg.warden_interrogation.not:
Recorded. This unit will return if the register requires it.

Three hundred and eleven statements outstanding. Four hundred and twelve were taken yesterday. The figure does not fall.
interregnum.dlg.warden_interrogation.fil:
Filed.

This unit is required to say that your cooperation has been noted. This unit would like to say something else and is not authorised to.

Unrecorded, then. That is permitted.

The register has a column for parties who decline. It has not been used before. This unit will use it correctly.
interregnum.dlg.warden_interrogation.off:
No. Statements must be taken by an authorised unit.

This unit is authorised. This unit will continue.
advancements.interregnum.deicide.title: Deicide
advancements.interregnum.deicide.descrip: The box was addressed to the holder. It did not say which one.
interregnum.ferry.quiet_one.no_sound: Refused for the crossing to the Unresponsive. A thing that can make a sound will make one, and there is no procedure for apologising after.
interregnum.ferry.anchorite.nothing_loos: Refused for the crossing to the Mass Authority. Nothing that pours. Where you are going, unanchored things go up, and they do not stop.
interregnum.ferry.verdant.nothing_stripp: Refused for the crossing to the Green Authority. You are carrying something you stripped. It will be recognised.
interregnum.ferry.hearth_turner.nothing_: Refused for the crossing to the Temporal Authority. You are carrying something you stopped from ageing. Of all of them, that one takes it personally.
interregnum.letter.anchorite.subject: SUBJECT: MASS AUTHORITY — no matter arising
interregnum.letter.anchorite.2: There is no matter arising. I have checked the register twice and there is nothing I am required to raise with you, which is why this has taken the form it has. The undersigned has no procedure for the other kind.
interregnum.letter.anchorite.3: You held the corner of it while I set the rest. I do not think either of us has said so since. Filed for the record, in case there is one.
interregnum.letter.verdant.subject: SUBJECT: GREEN AUTHORITY — return of duties
interregnum.letter.verdant.2: The duties you assumed during the interval have not been formally returned. This is not a complaint and no finding is recorded against you. The office simply notes that the interval ended some time ago and the register still lists you.
interregnum.letter.verdant.3: You did it well. That is also on the register and I have never known how to send it on its own.
interregnum.letter.hearth_turner.subject: SUBJECT: TEMPORAL AUTHORITY — request for a copy
interregnum.letter.hearth_turner.2: You will have kept it. You keep all of them. I am asking for the version where I was wrong, and I am asking because I no longer have it and I have looked.
interregnum.letter.hearth_turner.3: Send it as it was filed. Do not correct it on my account. I am aware that asking you not to correct a record is its own kind of request.
interregnum.letter.quiet_one.subject: SUBJECT: UNRESPONSIVE — further to previous
interregnum.letter.quiet_one.2: Further to previous. There is no previous on file that has been answered, so the office is unable to state which previous this is further to.
interregnum.letter.quiet_one.3: The sun is turned daily. Attendance is recorded. The undersigned continues to write and has stopped stating why.
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.covered: THE LONG GREEN: "The arrangement was temporary. I want that on the record before anyone says anything else. Temporary, agreed by both parties, and I have never once claimed otherwise."
"We were asked to bring you this."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.arrange: THE LONG GREEN: "There was a crisis. Someone had to hold the growing while it was dealt with, and I was the one who could. That is all covering is. You do the work and you hand it back." A pause, slightly too long. "When it is asked for."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.handove: THE LONG GREEN: "It was not." The green goes on growing, all around, at the rate it has been growing for an age. "I assumed that meant the arrangement stood. That is what an unreturned duty means. It means the other party is content."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.reads: It takes the letter the way something takes a thing it has been expecting for a long time and has still not prepared for. It reads. It reads it again. Nothing in the world stops growing, which somehow makes it worse.
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.reads.a: "Is it what you thought it was?"
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.called_: THE LONG GREEN: "Nobody has addressed me like that in a very long time." It folds the letter along a crease that is already there. "It is filed correspondence. There is a subject line. It wrote to me the way it wrote to everyone, and it still —" It stops. "It used the short form."
"You could have handed it back at any time."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.not_abo: THE LONG GREEN: "It will have wanted the duty returned. That will be what this is. I have had a very long time to think about how I would answer that."
"It never mentions the arrangement. Not once."
Say nothing. Let it keep the answer it prepared.
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.undefen: THE LONG GREEN reads it a third time, looking for the part it had built the answer for. "No," it says eventually. "It does not." The growing, for the first time since you arrived, is the only sound.
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.terms: THE LONG GREEN: "Then I do not know what I am being asked for." It looks at you as though you might. "You are carrying the rest of it. Whatever the estate is, you are the one holding it. So you had better tell me what the terms are — and you had better know that this world does not stop growing for a conversation."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.terms.a: "We will bring the rest. All of it."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.opened: THE LONG GREEN: "Then you will want to know how anything is kept here, before the green has it. That is a longer lesson than you think and you have already started it." It puts the letter somewhere you do not see. "Come back. Bring the others' when you have them."
interregnum.dlg.verdant_delivery.closes: THE LONG GREEN turns back to the growing, which has not needed it for a single moment of this conversation and will not stop needing it for as long as it exists. "Then the arrangement stands," it says. "As it has."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.weigh: Something enormous is holding still in a world where nothing else does. Gravel goes past you upward, unhurried, the way snow falls. OLD HEAVY: "What is the load." Not a question, quite. "Tell me the load and I will tell you if it can be set down."
"A letter. That is the whole load."
"Are you the one they call Old Heavy?"
"You look like you have been carrying something a long time."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.holdi: OLD HEAVY: "I am the one holding. That is not a name, it is a posture." Somewhere above, a whole hillside of sand is leaving. "Everything here goes up. I am aware of how that looks in a world that is supposed to be about weight. I am holding the only thing I was asked to hold. Say the load."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.reads: It does not take the letter so much as accept it, the way a foundation accepts a wall. It reads the subject line first, because that is what a filing is for. Then it stops, and the stopping is the loudest thing that has happened here in an age.
"It is filed correspondence. There is a whole register of it."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.no_ma: OLD HEAVY: "No matter arising." It says the phrase the way you would say a name. "That form is for reporting that there is nothing to report. It is what you file when the answer is *no change, carry on*." A pause with mass in it. "It checked the register twice to make sure it had nothing to tell me. Then it wrote to me anyway."
"It was thanking you. It only had the one form."
"What did the rest of it say?"
"It says there is no matter arising. That is all it says."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.the_c: OLD HEAVY: "It says I held the corner of it while it set the rest." The sand goes up. The gravel goes up. "I did. It never came back and said the setting was finished, so I did not let go. That was not devotion, you understand. Nobody told me the job was over. There is a difference and I have had a long time to consider it."
"The one who was setting it is dead. You can put it down."
Say nothing. It has not asked.
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.let_g: It is quiet for long enough that the falling — the rising — becomes something you can hear. "Yes," says OLD HEAVY. "I had worked that out from the form. A thing that files *no matter arising* to say the other kind is a thing settling its affairs." Nothing in the world comes down. "I will keep hold of it a while. Not because I have to. That is a different weight and I would like to feel it."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.still: OLD HEAVY does not ask, and you do not offer, and the two of you stand in it. "It will come back and tell me when the setting is done," it says, to nobody in particular. "That is the arrangement." Above you a mountain's worth of loose stone goes on leaving, patiently, forever.
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.terms: OLD HEAVY: "You are carrying the rest of the register. I can feel the load of it from here and it is not a heavy one, which is the worst thing about it." It shifts, fractionally, and the whole horizon acknowledges the movement. "Tell me what you want and be exact. I have no procedure for the other kind either."
"We are delivering all of it. Yours was the second."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.opene: OLD HEAVY: "Then learn to put things down before you leave here. Everything in this world is going up because nobody is holding it, and you will want to know the difference between a thing that is held and a thing that has merely not been dropped yet." A beat. "Bring the others' when you have them. I will be here. Obviously."
interregnum.dlg.anchorite_delivery.close: OLD HEAVY takes the weight it has been taking for an age, and goes on taking it, and says nothing else. Somewhere above, everything that was ever loose is still leaving.
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.a: The light here has not changed since you arrived and will not. Something is already holding out a folded copy, and has been for some time. THE TURNING: "Request for a copy. Temporal Authority. I have it here." A pause. "I have had it here."
"You have not read the letter yet."
"How long have you been holding that?"
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.w: THE TURNING: "It asked for the version where it was wrong. There are four. It will have meant the third, because that is the one where it stopped talking mid-sentence and did not finish, and that is the one anybody means." The copy does not move. "It asked me not to correct it. I have not corrected it. That took some doing."
"Show us. All four, if there are four."
"We only came to deliver the letter."
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.s: It shows you. Not a telling — the room ages backward around you in filed order: moss lifting off stone, cracks closing, four voices in a doorway that has not been built yet. The argument is smaller than you expected. It is about who was supposed to have said something first. THE TURNING, over it: "This is only the second. There is more. There is always more, that is the trouble with the arrangement."
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.t: The third one runs and it is very short. One of them says a thing that is true and unkind, in that order, and the other does not answer, and the light does not change because the light here never does. THE TURNING lets it finish. "It has been asking for this for a long time. Not in writing. It asked in the way you ask when you are hoping not to be answered." A beat. "This time it put it in writing."

THE TURNING: "It says: send it as it was filed." The copy is still held out and nobody has taken it. "I cannot send it. There is no longer an address. That is a clerical problem and I have been treating it as one, because the other way of putting it is not available to me." The light does not change. "Nothing here is ever over. That is the law. It is a very good law and I would like to file a complaint about it."
"Then give it to us. We will carry it."
"It is yours. It was always going to stay here."
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.h: It takes a long moment, because letting a record leave is the only thing this world has never done. Then the copy changes hands and the world does not end. THE TURNING watches its own hand for a while afterwards. "I keep every version," it says. "I have never given one away. I do not know yet what that makes this."
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.k: THE TURNING folds the copy along the crease it already has and puts it back where it has been. "Yes," it says. "That is the correct handling." The moss goes on growing at exactly the rate it has always grown, on stone that will be cracked by morning, and there is no morning.
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.t: THE TURNING: "You are carrying the others. I can tell which ones from how you stand." It does not elaborate and you would rather it did not. "Ask me for what you need. I have everything, in order, and no one has wanted any of it for an age. You will find that makes me easy to deal with and difficult to leave."
"We will bring the rest of the register. Yours was the third."
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.o: THE TURNING: "Then you will want the fourth version eventually, and I will not give it to you until you do. It is not a secret. It is simply not yet the thing you are asking about." The light holds where it is. "Come back. I will not have moved on."
interregnum.dlg.hearth_turner_delivery.c: THE TURNING files it, precisely, in the place it has always been, and begins keeping this conversation as well — in order, from the beginning, alongside everything else, for as long as there is anything to keep it in.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.arriv: There is something here. You can see where it is by what the light does around it. It does not turn toward you, and it does not turn away, and after a while you understand that neither of those is going to happen.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.offer: The letter stays in your hand. Nothing comes for it. Nothing declines it either — there is no gesture of refusal, no turning-away, none of the things a person does instead of taking something. The offer simply goes on being made.
Read it aloud. All of it.
Set it down where it can be reached.
"You could at least look at it."
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.no_pr: "Further to previous," the letter says. "There is no previous on file that has been answered, so the office is unable to state which previous this is further to." In the place where the words go, nothing happens to them. "The sun is turned daily. Attendance is recorded. The undersigned continues to write and has stopped stating why."
"How many were there? Before this one."
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.the_o: You do not get a number. What you get is the shape of one: somewhere in the quiet there is a place where things have been put, and it is not a small place, and every one of them was addressed the same way. None of them has been opened. None of them has been thrown away either.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.recei: The letter is delivered. That is the fact. Whether it has been RECEIVED is a different word and there is nobody here who will say it. The register you are carrying has a line for the date, a line for the item, and a line for the hand that took it.
Sign the line yourself. Record it as received.
Leave the line blank. It is not yours to fill.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.signe: You write in a hand that is not the one the line was meant for, and the ink is as loud as anything has been here. Nothing objects. Nothing agrees. The entry is now the only account of what happened in this room, and you are the one who wrote it.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.unsig: The line stays empty, and the empty line is a record too — of a letter delivered to somewhere it certainly arrived, and of nobody willing to say that it landed. The register will go back with that gap in it. Someone will read the gap one day and have to decide what it meant.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.leavi: There is nothing else to do here. There was never going to be. The light goes on doing the thing it does around whatever this is, and the letter is where you left it, and no part of the last hour has been acknowledged by anything except you.
"We will come back. Whether or not you want us to."
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.opene: You say it out loud and it is the last sound made in that place for a long time. On the way out you pass the spot where you first saw the light bend, and it is bending somewhere else now. Not toward you. Just somewhere it was not before.
interregnum.dlg.quiet_one_delivery.close: You go. Behind you the letter lies where it was set down, addressed to a dash, in a world that has never once said no to anything.
interregnum.ferry.inspection.hull: Hull of record: %s block(s). Findings below are per destination and are not appealable at this desk.
interregnum.ferry.inspection.nothing_bui: Nothing is attached to this keel. A keel alone is not a vessel and will not be logged as one.
interregnum.ferry.inspection.too_large: Hull exceeds the tonnage this desk is authorised to inspect. Reduce it. There is no larger desk.
interregnum.letter.unmarked: The seal is intact and the docket line is blank. Whoever filed this did not record which one it was.
interregnum.letter.missing: This is docketed %s. There is no such item in the register.
